diffs.diff: illuminance (lux, CH0 only, CH1/CH0<=0.5): datasheet reading gives 0.0304 per count, the part's model has 1, 1, 1, 1
diffs.evidence: The model's four sim measures (0xAC/0xAE/0x8C/0x8E) are raw ADC counts of DATA0/DATA1 (unit 'counts', scale 1), not lux, so 1 count per count is correct. Lux is computed in the driver's calculate_lux() exactly per the datasheet table (AV02-2315EN p.3, Note 8): '0 < CH1/CH0 <= 0.50  Sensor Lux = (0.0304 x CH0) - (0.062 x CH0 x ((CH1/CH0)^1.4))', plus the 0.50-0.61, 0.61-0.80, 0.80-1.30 and >1.30 segments, with the formula characterised in high gain mode at Tint = 402 ms ('(Sensor Lux)/(actual Lux), high gain mode (Note 8)'); the driver scales by 16 at low gain ('Note 7: Low gain mode has 16x lower gain than high gain mode') and by 322/11 or 322/81 for 13.7/101 ms ('Scaling between integration times ... 11/322 = 0.034, 81/322 = 0.252'). The second reading's 0.0304 is only the CH0 term of the lux formula (it ignores the CH1 correction term), which the model already contains; the example test value (CH0=2500, CH1=800 at 1x/402 ms -> 712.9 lux) matches the formula.
